subject.title: [Feature]: [Feature Request] 按用户维度统计 Token 使用量

question: Should OpenClaw core define a stable per-user accounting subject and viewer authorization model for usage reporting now, or should this remain plugin/external until broader Gateway principal work settles?
rationale: Current source has local usage totals and origin metadata, but no canonical identity, retention, aggregation, or authorization contract for billing-grade per-user views.

options.title: Define core accounting subject first
options.body: Add a maintainer-approved accounting subject and viewer permission model, then extend the usage RPCs and UI around that contract.

options.title: Defer to principal work
options.body: Keep this issue open but block implementation until Gateway multi-principal/authorship design settles.

options.title: Plugin or external only
options.body: Document current diagnostic events and usage exports as the supported path for custom per-user spend dashboards.

recommendation.title: Define core accounting subject first
recommendation.body: Add a maintainer-approved accounting subject and viewer permission model, then extend the usage RPCs and UI around that contract.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete has the strongest current-history signal across provider usage, shared usage types, Dashboard usage, and recent cost-analysis work.
